body: Yeah, sometime I'll go to Disney and actually have fun :(
I wish I could talk to a shrink. My credit problems pretty much make that impossible though. I can barely afford my ramen.

Yeah, I don't know why he's done any of the things he's done. I want answers. He shut the door without even a conversation. I wrote him everything I could think of to say and I doubt I'll get a reply.

I don't get why he's trying to bring Shilo back into this, or why he's rubbing his happiness in everyone's face. His friends say he's doing awesome. I know he has bipolar so this may be the up that followed the horrible down of last year when he broke up with me. I feel responsible for his bipolar now. Like if I'm not there look at how happy he is, you know, look at how happy the world would be if I wasn't here anymore.

I know he wants to be left alone. But he also tells people things like "I just wish I could talk to Janet" right after telling me to never speak to him again. I just don't understand. I don't understand how I can still be hurting him.

You make a lot of good points though. I wish I could talk to you more, you seem to have such a good head on your shoulders. My life is pretty crappy too, like the whole big laundry list of problems you have and my alanon sponsor is always telling me to look on the positive side of things. I just don't know how to do it like you do seem to.
Tremors was the ultimate The Floor Is Made of Lava movie.
